topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't believe they're closing. It's not just any place, you know? It's where you go to pretend everything is okay, even when it’s not. The smell of the bread as you walk in, the way the light hits the tables just right in the evening. I’ve spent so many nights there, with friends, with family, and even alone, and it’s been this constant, this one spot where things make sense. I don’t know what I’ll do without it. What if no other place ever feels as right? What if this is it? I need to find a way to keep this memory alive, but it’s hard to think about that right now.
